// This file is a compile-fail case, not production code. It is stored with a
// .go.txt suffix so the normal build never sees it, and is copied into a
// temporary package by TestAdapterWithoutVersionSignalDoesNotCompile.
//
// It declares a fifth adapter that implements every SourceAdapter method
// except VersionSignal and then asserts it satisfies the interface. Building
// it must fail: that failure is the compiler enforcing that a new adapter
// declares where its version lives, or declares that it has none.
package compilefail

import (
	"context"
	"io"

	"github.com/adewale/aha/internal/adapters"
	"github.com/adewale/aha/internal/model"
)

type adapterWithoutVersionSignal struct{}

func (adapterWithoutVersionSignal) Name() string    { return "no-version-signal" }
func (adapterWithoutVersionSignal) Version() string { return "v1" }

func (adapterWithoutVersionSignal) DefaultRoots() []model.DefaultRoot {
	return []model.DefaultRoot{{OS: "all", Path: "~/.no-version-signal"}}
}

func (adapterWithoutVersionSignal) Capabilities() model.AdapterCapabilities {
	return model.AdapterCapabilities{}
}

func (adapterWithoutVersionSignal) Discover(ctx context.Context, config model.SourceConfig) ([]model.SessionFile, error) {
	return nil, nil
}

func (adapterWithoutVersionSignal) DiscoverArtifacts(ctx context.Context, session model.SessionFile) ([]model.ArtifactFile, error) {
	return nil, nil
}

func (adapterWithoutVersionSignal) ParseSession(ctx context.Context, file model.SessionFile, r io.Reader) (*model.ParsedSession, error) {
	return &model.ParsedSession{}, nil
}

// Deliberately missing:
//
//	func (adapterWithoutVersionSignal) VersionSignal(entry model.ParsedEntry) model.VersionSignal
var _ adapters.SourceAdapter = adapterWithoutVersionSignal{}
